description: This PHP source file defines the class Fast404ExceptionHtmlSubscriber, a Drupal event subscriber that handles high-performance 404 responses for HTML requests by returning minimalistic responses based on configuration settings. It includes methods for handling 404 errors, configuration change events, and manages cache invalidation.

classes.name: Fast404ExceptionHtmlSubscriber
classes.description: A Drupal event subscriber class that provides high-performance handling of 404 errors for HTML requests by returning minimal responses based on configuration settings.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the configuration factory and cache tags invalidator dependencies.

methods.name: getPriority
methods.description: Returns the priority of the event subscriber, set to a high value (200) for precedence.

methods.name: getHandledFormats
methods.description: Specifies that this subscriber handles 'html' format responses.

methods.name: on404
methods.description: Handles 404 errors for HTML requests by returning a minimal HTML response if the request path matches configured patterns.

methods.name: onConfigSave
methods.description: Invalidates cache tags when the 'system.performance' configuration related to fast 404 is changed.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Registers the onConfigSave method to listen for configuration save events.
